```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


**Purpose:**
Processes single cell RNA-seq datasets and generates the DESeq2 objects for use in downstream analyses

**Datasets:**
1. Yang et al.
2. Vasilesvka et al.
3. Pozniak et al.
4. Jerby-Arnon et al. 

**Outputs:**
Seurat objects for each dataset for use in downstream analyses.


# Yang et al.

**Source:** GEO GSE164614


# Set up necessary background

## Libraries

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(here)
  library(GSEABase)
  library(R.utils)
  library(Seurat)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  #library(SeuratData)
  #library(SeuratDisk)
})


```

## Generate Location to save Files

```{r}

#generate results directory in current folder
resultsDir1 <- here("data","data_objects")

# Automatically create the folder on the computer if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(resultsDir1)) {
  dir.create(resultsDir1, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Add location of counts files heres
pathToCounts <- "C:/path/to/Counts"

```

# scRNA-seq dataset 1 (Yang et al.)

**Source:** GEO GSE164614
Ensure file names are in the form "XX.tsv.gz" only

```{r GSE164614}
# double check names
# Rename genes.tsv.gz to features.tsv.gz in your folder
old_name <- file.path(pathToCounts, "GSE164614", "genes.tsv.gz")
new_name <- file.path(pathToCounts, "GSE164614", "features.tsv.gz")

if (file.exists(old_name)) {
  file.rename(from = old_name, to = new_name)
}

counts.matrix <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(pathToCounts,"GSE164614"))

yang <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts.matrix, 
  project = "MyProject", 
  min.cells = 3, 
  min.features = 200
)

# add Conditions
yang$Condition <- ifelse(grepl("-1$", colnames(yang)), "treated", "untreated")

# percentage feature set
yang <- PercentageFeatureSet(yang, pattern = "^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")


VlnPlot(
    yang,
    features = c(
        "nFeature_RNA",
        "nCount_RNA",
        "percent.mt"
    ),
    ncol = 3
)


# sctransform
yang <- SCTransform(yang, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt", verbose = FALSE)

# save object
SaveSeuratRds(object = yang,  file = file.path(resultsDir1,"yang.rds"))


```

# scRNA-seq dataset 2 (Vasilevska et al.)

**Source:** GEO GSE229908
Download `GSE229908_FNA_SCE.rds.gz` before running this section. Do not unzip.

```{r}
# file location
path_zipped <- file.path(pathToCounts,"GSE229908","GSE229908_FNA_SCE.rds.gz")
path_unzipped <- file.path(pathToCounts,"GSE229908","GSE229908_FNA_SCE.rds")


# check if file is unzip
if (!file.exists(path_unzipped)) {
  message("Uncompressing ", gz_file, "...")
  R.utils::gunzip(path_zipped, remove = FALSE)
} else {
  message("Unzipped file already exists. Skipping gunzip.")
}

vasilevska_SCE <- readRDS(path_unzipped)

# convert to seurat
vasilevska <- as.Seurat(
  vasilevska_SCE, 
  counts = "counts",     # Name of the assay slot for raw counts
  data = "logcounts",    # Name of the assay slot for normalized/log data (set to NULL if none exists)
  project = "GSE229908"  # Optional project name
)

# percentage feature set
vasilevska <- PercentageFeatureSet(vasilevska, pattern = "^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")


VlnPlot(
    vasilevska,
    features = c(
        "nFeature_RNA",
        "nCount_RNA",
        "percent.mt"
    ),
    ncol = 3
)

# Skip QC_Filtering (has already been filtered)


# perform sctransform
vasilevska <- PercentageFeatureSet(vasilevska, pattern = "^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")
vasilevska <- SCTransform(vasilevska, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt", verbose = FALSE)

SaveSeuratRds(object = vasilevska,  file = file.path(resultsDir1,"vasilevska.rds"))

```

# scRNA-seq dataset 3 (Pozniak et al.)

**Source:** EGA: EGAD00001009291

**Inputs:**
EGAD00001009291 was provided as a pre-generated Seurat object. Therefore, analysis begins from the provided Seurat object rather than from raw sequencing files.

# scRNA-seq dataset 4 (Jerby-Arnon et al.)

**Source:** GEO GSE115978

**Memory requirement:**  
This dataset is memory intensive. If there is limited memory available, it is recommended to run this in a fresh R session. 

```{r GSE115978}
counts_file <- list.files(file.path(pathToCounts,"GSE115978"), pattern = "counts\\.csv\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)
anno_file   <- list.files(file.path(pathToCounts,"GSE115978"), pattern = "cell\\.annotations\\.csv\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)

# safety check
if (length(counts_file) == 0) stop("Could not find the counts file in the specified directory.")
if (length(anno_file) == 0)   stop("Could not find the annotation file in the specified directory.")


message("Loading count matrix...")
counts_df <- fread(counts_file, data.table = FALSE)
rownames(counts_df) <- counts_df[, 1]
counts_matrix <- as.matrix(counts_df[, -1])


message("Reading annotation file: ", basename(anno_file))
metadata_df <- fread(anno_file, data.table = FALSE)
rownames(metadata_df) <- metadata_df[, 1]

jerbyarnon <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts_matrix,
  meta.data = metadata_df,
  project = "GSE115978",
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = 200
)

# Clear variables from memory
rm(counts_df, counts_matrix, metadata_df)
gc()

# percentage feature set
jerbyarnon <- PercentageFeatureSet(jerbyarnon, pattern = "^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")


VlnPlot(
    jerbyarnon,
    features = c(
        "nFeature_RNA",
        "nCount_RNA",
        "percent.mt"
    ),
    ncol = 3
)

# QC_Filtering not necessary as authors seem to have done it already
# perform sctransform
jerbyarnon <- SCTransform(jerbyarnon, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt", verbose = FALSE)

SaveSeuratRds(object = jerbyarnon,  file = file.path(resultsDir1,"jerbyarnon.rds"))
```
